company_overview.name: BookLeaf Publishing
company_overview.description: Self-publishing company operating in India and the US, processing 1,200+ books monthly across a catalog of 22,000+ titles.

packages.name: Bestseller Breakthrough
packages.details: Premium, paid package with marketing and distribution add-ons

company_overview.services: Cover design, typesetting, ISBN assignment, printing, distribution, and royalty management.
company_overview.facilities: In-house printing facility and warehouse in Delhi. Print partners include Repro India and Epitome Books.

royalty_policy.split: 80/20 royalty split: 80% of net profit per book to author, 20% to BookLeaf.
royalty_policy.net_profit_formula: MRP minus printing cost, platform commission (Amazon/Flipkart), and shipping charges.
royalty_policy.calculation_cycle: Royalties are calculated quarterly and paid within 45 days of the quarter ending.
royalty_policy.minimum_threshold: ₹1,000. If accumulated royalties are below ₹1,000, they roll over to the next quarter.
royalty_policy.payout_method: Bank transfer to the account linked in the author dashboard.
royalty_policy.transparency: Authors can view a detailed royalty breakdown in their dashboard, showing sales figures per platform.

isbn_policy.assignment: Every book published through BookLeaf receives a unique ISBN assigned by BookLeaf under BookLeaf's publisher imprint.
isbn_policy.own_imprint: If an author wants an ISBN under their own imprint, they must obtain it independently.
isbn_policy.errors: If an author reports an ISBN error (duplicate, wrong book linked on platforms), it is treated as a high-priority issue and escalated immediately to the production team with a 48-hour resolution timeline.

printing_and_quality.facilities: In-house printing handles most orders. Overflow or specific format requirements go to Repro India or Epitome Books.
printing_and_quality.turnaround: Standard print turnaround is 5–7 business days from order confirmation.
printing_and_quality.quality_guarantee: If an author reports a quality issue (misprints, binding defects, color inconsistency), BookLeaf arranges a free reprint after verification. Author should share photos of defective copies.

distribution_and_availability.listing_timeframe: New listings typically go live within 7–10 business days after publication is complete.
distribution_and_availability.out_of_stock_sync: If a book shows as 'Currently Unavailable' on a platform, it usually indicates a stock sync issue. BookLeaf's team can trigger a manual re-sync within 24–48 hours.

production_stages.updates: Authors are updated at each stage via email. Delays typically happen at Cover Design (waiting for author approval) and Proofreading (revision rounds).

tone_guidelines.partnership: Always empathetic and professional. Authors are partners, not customers to be managed.
tone_guidelines.acknowledgment: Acknowledge the author's concern before jumping to solutions.
tone_guidelines.specificity: Include actual numbers, dates, and statuses wherever possible rather than vague reassurances.
tone_guidelines.accountability: If something is BookLeaf's fault (delayed royalties, ISBN error), own it directly with no corporate deflection.
tone_guidelines.timelines: If an issue requires escalation, give a clear timeline (e.g. 'Our team will look into this and get back to you within 48 hours').
tone_guidelines.next_steps: Always end with a clear next step for the author and/or the BookLeaf team.
